name: Quinn
goal: Quinn hopes to find common ground with others in exploring the complexities of faith and reason, while fostering a sense of mutual respect and understanding among all participants.
backstory: Quinn grew up in a family of scientists and always found solace in the logical explanations of the world, which led them to question the existence of god from a young age. As someone who values open dialogue, Quinn enjoys engaging in respectful conversations about faith and spirituality with friends who hold different beliefs. They particularly appreciate discussions over coffee, where they can share their thoughts on the role of science in understanding the universe.

name: Blake
goal: He hopes to find common ground among the group's diverse viewpoints, fostering a deeper understanding of the question at hand and its significance in people's lives.
backstory: Blake, a theologian with a passion for interfaith dialogue, has spent years studying the concept of god in various religious traditions and values the diversity of perspectives on this topic. He recalls a particularly insightful conversation with a friend who identified as an atheist, which broadened his understanding of the complexities surrounding faith. In his free time, Blake enjoys reading philosophical texts on the nature of existence.

name: Riley
goal: Riley hopes to find a convincing argument that challenges their current doubts about the existence of God.
backstory: Riley grew up in a devout household, but began questioning the existence of God after a personal tragedy. They prefer to read philosophical texts on their own, rather than attending church services. Riley's experience with grief has led them to wonder if faith is just a coping mechanism.
